Oneliner

Country's second satellite.
Description

Paraguay’s national space agency AEP has begun a project to develop the country's second satellite, GuaraniSAT-2.

The second device will follow the same lines, with the design, assembly, integration, launch and operation of GuaraníSAT-2 satellite set to be carried out by Paraguayan engineers trained in Japan, the Paraguayan government said.

As part of the new project, Paraguay said it will carry out a set of initiatives with national laboratories within SPACELab, a network of space systems laboratories.
